```yaml
architecture:
  style: clean-architecture
  layers:
    - name: common
      kind: cross-cutting
      directories:
        - src/common/**
      file_patterns:
        - "src/common/**/*.ts"
      roles:
        - helper
        - adapter
    - name: domain
      directories:
        - src/domain/**
      file_patterns:
        - "src/domain/**/*.ts"
      roles:
        - entity
        - value-object
        - use-case-interface
    - name: application
      directories:
        - src/application/**
      file_patterns:
        - "src/application/**/*.ts"
      roles:
        - use-case
        - port
        - validation
        - application-error
    - name: presentation
      directories:
        - src/presentation/**
      file_patterns:
        - "src/presentation/**/*.ts"
      roles:
        - controller
        - middleware
        - response
    - name: infrastructure
      directories:
        - src/infrastructure/**
      file_patterns:
        - "src/infrastructure/**/*.ts"
      roles:
        - repository-impl
        - middleware
        - orm-entity
        - route
    - name: main
      directories:
        - src/main/**
      file_patterns:
        - "src/main/**/*.ts"
      roles:
        - factory

default_exclude_paths:
  - "node_modules/**"
  - "dist/**"
  - "**/*.spec.ts"
  - "**/*.test.ts"
  - "src/infrastructure/knex/migrations/**"
  - "src/infrastructure/knex/seeds/**"

fitness_overrides:
  - id: FF-S03
    enabled: false
    reason: "README says main may depend on all layers and the flow runs infrastructure -> presentation -> application -> domain, so layer skipping is normal here."
```
